info.title: Aphel console API
info.description: Operator console of a multi-tenant Aphel installation, served only on CONSOLE_HOST. Sessions use the `aphel_console_session` cookie; requests that change data send `X-Requested-With: aphel`.

200.description: Optional modules and blueprints a new tenant can start with, and whether tenants can be exported

201.description: Password chosen, operator active and signed in
Operator invited; `invite_url` is shown once and valid for 7 days

200.description: Operator deactivated and signed out everywhere
A new invitation link; the previous one stops working

429.description: Too many attempts (`rate_limited`) or the account is locked for a few minutes (`console_sign_in_locked`)

204.description: Password changed; the operator's other sessions are revoked

422.description: Wrong current password (`operator_password_wrong`) or invalid new password (`operator_password_invalid`)

200.description: Every tenant with its hosts, state, database size and last write

202.description: Tenant registered as `provisioning`; the database, migrations and installation run in the background and the tenant turns `active`, or keeps `last_error`

422.description: Invalid slug, name, host or administrator password (`tenant_slug_invalid`, `tenant_name_invalid`, `tenant_host_invalid`, `operator_password_invalid`)

202.description: Tenant marked `deleting`; the export (into TENANT_EXPORT_DIR), file removal and database drop run in the background

503.description: Export asked but this build cannot export (`configuration_error`)

200.description: Features saved. With `plugin_management` off, the organization cannot open the plugins screen or install, enable, disable, configure or remove plugins (`plugin_management_disabled`); enabled plugins keep running
Jobs, workers, pending migrations, plugin backend errors and recent failures of an active tenant; `available` is false otherwise
Host removed; the next host becomes primary when the primary is removed
Modules compiled into this build and their state in the organization

409.description: The module is enabled or was not exported after being disabled
An enabled module depends on it (`module_required_by`) or the build requires it (`module_required`)
Incompatible module or a dependency is disabled

200.description: Runtime plugins installed in the organization, in the shape of the organization API (`PluginResponse`)

404.description: Unknown tenant (`tenant_not_found`) or no plugin module in this build (`module_not_installed`)

post.description: Installs or upgrades a plugin in the organization from an `.aphelplugin` sent as the multipart field `package`, with the same checks and acknowledgements as the organization API. With `dry_run=true` nothing is installed and the response describes what the package asks for. Works even when the organization's plugin management is switched off.

200.description: Dry run: what the package declares and asks for (`PluginConsentResponse`)

409.description: Conflicts or web code not acknowledged

post.description: Installs or upgrades a plugin pack (`.aphelpack`, multipart field `package`) in the organization. With `dry_run=true` nothing is installed and the response describes the pack. Status 207 means some plugins failed.

200.description: Dry run: what the pack declares and asks for

207.description: Some plugins of the pack failed

409.description: Conflicts or web code not acknowledged

200.description: Plugin catalog readiness (`loading`, `ready` or `degraded`) and backend errors

204.description: Plugin removed; with `purge=true` its records and fields are deleted too

409.description: Web code or overlaps not acknowledged

200.description: Grants reapplied to the roles that exist now (`PluginResponse`)
Settings with their current values (`PluginSettingResponse[]`); secrets only report `configured`

requestBody.description: Map of setting key to value

200.description: Tenant suspended: its hosts answer 503 and its jobs stop

get.description: Update service availability, installed version, latest stable release, operation and history

409.description: Update state changed or another operation is running

post.description: Confirm a prepared update; the external service backs up data, restarts the installation and records the outcome

409.description: Update state changed or another operation is running

post.description: Check the latest stable release without changing the running application

409.description: Update state changed or another operation is running

post.description: Download and verify the latest stable image; does not restart the application
